text.p: Future Petroleum Corp said Friday recompletion of its Linda 1 well located in the Bar Nine Field in Hutchinson County, Texas, boosted production to 163,000 cubic feet daily from 20,000.

The company said the well was re-completed by adding new perforations in the well's brown dolomite zone and by an acid treatment to clear existing perforations of debris and thus improve gas flow. About 35 feet of new perforations were added, expanding the perforated zone by 88 percent.
The company noted it owns an additional well in the Bar Nine Field for which it plans a similar re-completion in the brown dolomite zone within the next quarter.

"With this re-completion project, we converted a marginally economic well to economic status and achieved results that will enable recovery of the money spent in less than three months," said Carl Price, president.
